summary: Full auth/orders/favorites testing of KMB STORE. Backend: 15/15 pytest cases pass (auth/me 401 unauth, 200 with Bearer; orders create/list newest-first; favorites toggle on/off + full products payload; logout invalidates session; regression on products/config/admin CRUD). Frontend UI: unauthenticated /compte shows google-login-button and header login-button (no account-button). After seeding httpOnly session_token cookie, /compte renders account-header with correct name/email, Commandes+Favoris tabs, orders-list + favorites-list; header shows account-button (login-button hidden). ProductCard favorite-button-{id} toggles and shows the product on /compte favorites tab. Product page favorite-button works; after selecting size 42 + Cocody, summary-total = 44 000 FCFA; clicking WhatsApp opens api.whatsapp.com link AND records an order (verified 1 order rendered on /compte). Logout clears user; google-login-button reappears + 'Déconnecté' toast shown.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py Account.jsx: 'profil' tab is defined in state default but there is no data-testid='tab-profile' button; the profil branch renders null and the orders list also renders whenever tab !== 'favoris', so 'profil' effectively shows the orders list. Consider removing the dead 'profil' state or add a Profile tab UI.
AuthContext.completeLogin: no try/catch around setUser/loadFavorites; AuthCallback wraps it but any error inside loadFavorites is swallowed silently. Acceptable but worth noting.
Backend get_current_user: user_sessions.expires_at is stored as ISO string; parsing works but consider storing as native BSON Date for consistent index/TTL usage.
server.py stores users/sessions with ISO strings (created_at/expires_at) but seed script in auth_testing.md uses new Date(); code handles both via isinstance(str) check - fine.
test_credentials: Admin password: admin123 (X-Admin-Password header). Customer auth via seeded mongosh session token used as Bearer / cookie (see /app/auth_testing.md).
seed_data_creation: Ephemeral users/user_sessions inserted for pytest and playwright runs; cleaned up post-test via mongosh deleteMany. No production/seeded data modified.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend regression file: /app/backend/tests/test_auth_orders_favorites.py (uses subprocess mongosh to seed sessions; requires REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL env or reads frontend/.env). DB name: test_database. All 6 review requirements verified end-to-end.
